answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 49 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The signal schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the zenith checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 50 effective identities must lock that capital for 49 epochs and keep it locked through every quartz audit. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
